entities.summary: Anne Stella Fomumbod is a Cameroonian women's rights activist. She is the founder and CEO of the Interfaith Vision Foundation of Cameroon (IVFCam), and the driving force behind the Metta Charter on Widowhood, which has enabled significant progress in the human right of widows in her country.
